entities.summary: The Hajj (Mecca), Camino de Santiago (Spain), Canterbury (England), and Varanasi (India) drew millions of pilgrims. Pilgrimage was both spiritual obligation and international adventure — travelers crossed continents, shared stories, and spread ideas. Chaucer's Canterbury Tales captures the social mixing.
